parameters.formDescription: Upload your pitch book (PDF or TXT) that states your key numbers. Your application is reviewed blind: names, schools, photos and graphics are never passed to evaluators.

parameters.content:
## Blind VC Pitch Book Screener
1. Founder uploads PDF/TXT pitch book
2. Only labelled numbers are read (Monthly Revenue, Monthly Costs, Users Last Month, Users This Month, Cash in Bank, Funding Ask, Industry, Business Summary)
3. Names, schools, links, hype are redacted
4. Scored on numbers only
5. Download the HTML + CSV from the last two nodes: Output > Binary > Download
